title: Multidisciplinary oral rehabilitation of an adolescent suffering from juvenile Gorlin-Goltz syndrome-a case report
authors: Nilius M, Kohlhase J, Lorenzen J, Lauer G, Schulz MC. 2019. Head Face Med;15(1):5.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “In the presented case could be shown that distraction osteogenesis of prefabricated bone blocks is possible. With a multidisciplinary approach in a long -term treatment, a sufficient oral rehabilitation of the patient suffering from extended keratocystic odontogenic tumors was possible” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
